verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an agent platform with a public REST API, so this axis applies. However, the evidence documents no sandbox, test-mode, or dry-run environment isolated from production data. Self-hosting, local client-side storage, and free trials are adjacent deployment or data-location features or user-side workarounds, not a product-provided sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
